MATH · ONTARIO

Ontario Course Codes

Codes used on this site: a short Ontario description and links to our lessons for each course. This is not the full ministry curriculum.

Course codes

Grade 9 · MTH1W · Mathematics
Ontario Curriculum Connection

What this code means: M = Mathematics; TH = the compulsory Grade 9 course; 1 = Grade 9; W = de-streamed (one course for all students, not Applied vs Academic).

The Ontario curriculum for Grade 9 Mathematics (de-streamed) emphasizes algebraic thinking, relationships among representations, and problem solving across number, algebra, data, geometry, and measurement strands.

“Students develop algebraic concepts and make connections between number and algebra using different tools and representations.”

— Ontario Curriculum: Secondary Mathematics, Grade 9 (MTH1W), Ministry of Education.

Official source: https://www.dcp.edu.gov.on.ca/en/curriculum/secondary-mathematics/courses/mth1w

How topics on this site connect

Topics on this site tagged MTH1W support expressions, equations, linear relations, and foundational function ideas at the Grade 9 level.

Grade 10 · MPM2D · Principles of Mathematics
Ontario Curriculum Connection

What this code means: M = Mathematics; PM = Principles of Mathematics (this course line); 2 = Grade 10; D = Academic (university-oriented pathway in Grades 9–10).

The Ontario Grade 10 Principles course develops reasoning with quadratics, trigonometry, analytic geometry, and linear systems, with emphasis on problem solving and communication.

“Students continue to build on their understanding of linear relations and extend their thinking to quadratic relations and trigonometry.”

— The Ontario Curriculum, Grades 9 and 10: Mathematics, Ontario Ministry of Education, Principles of Mathematics, Grade 10, Academic (MPM2D).

Official source: https://www.edu.gov.on.ca/eng/curriculum/secondary/math910currb.pdf

How topics on this site connect

Lessons tagged MPM2D on this site include introductory trigonometry, transformations, and quadratic patterns that align with early Principles topics.

Grade 11 · MCR3U · Functions
Ontario Curriculum Connection

What this code means: M = Mathematics; CR = Functions (this course); 3 = Grade 11; U = University preparation.

The Ontario Ministry of Education describes the Grade 11 Functions course as follows:

“Students will reason mathematically and communicate their thinking as they solve multi-step problems.”

— The Ontario Curriculum, Grades 11 and 12: Mathematics, Ontario Ministry of Education, 2007, Functions, Grade 11, University Preparation (MCR3U), page 43.

Official source: https://www.edu.gov.on.ca/eng/curriculum/secondary/math1112currb.pdf

How topics on this site connect

Topics tagged MCR3U extend trigonometry, identities, and function reasoning for university-preparation Functions.
